entities.summary: Dominika Anna Krois is a Polish civil servant, diplomat and legal scholar who served as a Permanent Representative of Poland to the United Nations Office at Vienna (2019–2024). Since 2024, she is the Representative and Director of the United Nations Office in Belgrade.
